title: Understand your conversion tracking data
summary: Explains how conversion counts, conversion rate, value, cost per conversion, and attribution settings are reported. Useful when a PM must define an outcome metric and question whether a dashboard number is comparable across channels.

title: About the Experiments page
summary: Describes controlled campaign experiments that split traffic or budget between an original and a proposed change. Supports PM decisions about hypotheses, comparison periods, and whether a measured change justifies rollout.

title: Best practices for your Sponsored Products ads
summary: Introduces sponsored retail placements and the advertiser controls around targets, bids, and budgets. Its reporting section distinguishes exposure, clicks, attributed sales, and cost, which helps specify advertiser-facing metrics.

title: Your complete guide to Sponsored Brands
summary: Connects brand discovery goals with impressions, new-to-brand purchases, and return on ad spend. Useful for explaining why a PM should not treat one efficiency ratio as the only measure of a discovery product.

title: Basic metrics and definitions in TikTok Ads Manager
summary: Defines reach, impressions, frequency, clicks, conversions, conversion rates, and cost measures for an ads dashboard. Helps keep similar-looking commercial metrics distinct in requirements and evaluations.

title: About Conversion Lift Study
summary: Describes a test-versus-control approach for estimating conversions caused by ad exposure. A PM can use it to distinguish incremental impact from conversions merely attributed to a campaign.

title: Recurring pricing models
summary: Outlines flat-rate, per-seat, tiered, and usage-based recurring pricing structures. Supports product choices about how value, usage, and customer understanding map to a plan design.

title: Strategy of pricing: How to build, test, and improve your pricing model
summary: Surveys different bases for setting a price and stresses customer value, costs, competition, and model fit. Useful for framing pricing as a testable PM decision rather than a number chosen in isolation.

title: How to grow subscription revenue
summary: Covers subscription packaging, retention, customer experience, and experiments as revenue levers. Provides broad commercial context for a PM balancing conversion with sustained customer value.

title: Measure results with Spotify Ad Analytics
summary: Explains delivery reporting, attribution and conversion lift, and brand lift for audio campaigns. Gives a second platform example of separating ad exposure from downstream business effects.
